title: Domain combat events plus first generic Projectile presentation contract
objective: Close the missing CombatEvent seam from the skill resolver and prove that a generic Projectile presentation plan consumes immutable resolved combat facts without owning or mutating damage/resource truth.
hypothesis: If SkillCastResolution emits immutable SkillCast/Damage/TargetDefeated facts and a pure-C# Projectile planner consumes only those facts plus SkillDefinition presentation metadata, then Unity/VFX can later attach to that plan without gaining authority over combat mechanics.
claim_boundary: No UnityEngine dependency, prefab playback, timing values, camera, sound, VFX fidelity, Unity compile/runtime or original PAL3 visual fidelity is claimed by this experiment.

attempts.description: Emit SkillCast/Damage/optional TargetDefeated facts from the already-resolved single-target skill result; build a timing-free generic Projectile cue plan and verify that planning cannot mutate encounter HP/MP.

pre_merge_review.finding: The public types exposed IReadOnlyList but initially retained raw arrays as their backing objects, so a caller could theoretically cast the returned object back to an array and mutate event/cue contents.
pre_merge_review.fix: Store Array.AsReadOnly wrappers for SkillCastResolution.Events and SkillPresentationPlan.Cues, then add a regression test proving neither public collection is a mutable array alias.

verified_capabilities: Single-target skill resolution emits ordered immutable SkillCast and Damage domain facts and an optional TargetDefeated fact.
Projectile presentation planning consumes resolved facts after HP/MP mutation has completed.
Presentation planning mirrors resolved damage and cannot recalculate or mutate combat truth.
The first generic presentation plan contains Cast, Travel, Impact and optional TargetDefeated cues without inventing timing values.
VisualProfileKey and SkillVisualArchetype remain presentation metadata separated from mechanics.
Public event and cue collections are read-only wrappers rather than mutable array aliases.
unverified_or_blocked: No UnityEngine presentation adapter or prefab playback exists yet.
No cast/travel/impact timing values are claimed.
Camera, sound, hit reactions and damage-number rendering are not implemented.
Unity compile/runtime remains separately blocked by activation prerequisites.
reusable_lessons: Resolved combat facts should cross the presentation boundary; presentation must not receive authority to recompute mechanics.
Do not invent visual timing constants when the evidence does not establish them.
IReadOnlyList alone does not guarantee an immutable backing object; protect public contracts against array-alias mutation before calling them immutable.
A first-attempt green build may still deserve pre-merge contract hardening without rewriting history as a failed attempt.
next_recommended_experiment: Proceed to Step 5 multi-target target resolution in the pure domain while reusing the same CombatEvent/presentation boundary; attach a real Unity Projectile adapter only when Unity activation is available.
